title: Concurrent Gainers: 9 smallcap stocks gain for 5 days in a row
text: Concurrent Gainers: 9 smallcap stocks gain for 5 days in a row. We identified 12 stocks that gained on all five days, delivering cumulative returns ranging from 10% to 30% during the period.
